subject.title: feat: Cron job tags/categories for organization and filtering

question: Should cron organization use freeform user tags, a narrower typed purpose/display metadata contract, or stay name/search-based for now?
rationale: The request changes persisted cron job shape, Gateway protocol, CLI/API behavior, and Control UI semantics, and the related metadata PR was closed as needing owner-reviewed API direction.

options.title: Typed purpose/display metadata
options.body: Add a small first-party classification/display contract that can serve reminders and future system/user/project views without arbitrary opaque API growth.

options.title: Freeform tags
options.body: Add optional user-managed string tags plus filters and bulk actions, accepting a broader taxonomy surface in the cron API.

options.title: No new field
options.body: Keep cron organization based on name, description, search, and existing filters until a stronger use case defines the durable contract.

recommendation.title: Typed purpose/display metadata
recommendation.body: Add a small first-party classification/display contract that can serve reminders and future system/user/project views without arbitrary opaque API growth.

likelyOwner.reason: He provided the closest maintainer signal by closing the related metadata PR as requiring owner-reviewed API/protocol design.
